Question Choices: How many endpoints does a line segment have?
Hints: Use dimensions, endpoints and arrowheads to distinguish a point, line, segment, ray and plane.
Solution: A segment has two endpoints, one at each end. It stops at both endpoints.

Question Choices: A line goes on forever in only one direction. Is this statement True or False?
Hints: Use dimensions, endpoints and arrowheads to distinguish a point, line, segment, ray and plane.
Solution: A line continues in both directions. A ray, not a line, continues in only one direction from an endpoint.

Question Choices: Select which of these figures has zero dimensions?: ~~Line | Point | Plane~~
Hints: Use dimensions, endpoints and arrowheads to distinguish a point, line, segment, ray and plane.
Solution: A point has zero dimensions. A line has one dimension and a plane has two.

Question Choices: How many endpoints does a ray have?
Hints: Use dimensions, endpoints and arrowheads to distinguish a point, line, segment, ray and plane.
Solution: A ray has one endpoint and continues forever in one direction.

Question Choices: Select.The straight edges of a triangle are examples of what geometric figure?: ~~Point | Line | Line-segment | Ray | Angle~~
Hints: Use dimensions, endpoints and arrowheads to distinguish a point, line, segment, ray and plane.
Solution: Each edge joins two vertices and stops at both. A point has no length, a line continues both ways, a ray continues one way, and an angle is formed by two rays.

Question Choices: You have three non-collinear points (A B and C). How many unique line segments can be drawn by connecting pairs of these points?
Hints: Choose every unordered pair of distinct points once. Avoid counting AB and BA twice.
Solution: Choose each pair once: 3 x 2 / 2 = 3 segments. Reversing the two endpoint names does not create a new segment.

Question Choices: Point M is the midpoint of line segment AB. If the length of segment AB is 10 cm, what is the length from A to M?
Hints: A midpoint divides the segment into two equal lengths.
Solution: The midpoint splits 10 cm into two equal parts: 10 / 2 = 5 cm. Check: 5 + 5 = 10.

Question Choices: Select the starting point of this ray: ~~C | D~~
Hints: In a ray name, the first letter is the endpoint. Order matters.
Solution: The ray is named CD. The first letter C is its endpoint; the ray continues through D.

Question Choices: Select. Is ray (a) same as ray (b) ? ~~Yes | No~~
Hints: In a ray name, the first letter is the endpoint. Order matters.
Solution: Ray AB begins at A and goes through B. Ray BA begins at B and goes through A. They have different endpoints and are not the same ray.

Question Choices: Select which geometric figure is described as a set of points extending infinitely in both directions?: ~~Ray | Line-segment | Line | Point~~
Hints: Use dimensions, endpoints and arrowheads to distinguish a point, line, segment, ray and plane.
Solution: A line continues forever in both directions and has no endpoints. A ray continues only one way; a segment has two endpoints.
